Pandora Drive: Your Trusted Safety App for Over a Decade

Get started with Pandora Drive for free and access all your files from any smartphone, tablet, or computer. Your videos, photos, and documents are securely backed up in the Cloud, ensuring you never lose them. Effortlessly invite others to view, edit, or comment on any of your files or folders.

Trusted Since 2010
Available on the App Store since 2010, Pandora Drive has received outstanding feedback in China, the USA, and across Asia. Trust us for unparalleled safety and reliability.



With Pandora Drive, you can:

Access Various File Types: 
View documents, PDFs, photos, videos, and more.

Seamlessly Share Files and Folders: 
Share with others and manage permissions for viewing, commenting, or editing.

Track File Activity: 
See file details and activity logs.

Offline Access: 
Enable offline viewing of files.



Key Features:
Easy Importing: 
Import directly from your camera album, USB transport, and WiFi with a web manager.

Enhanced Photo Viewer: 
Enjoy a new and improved photo viewing experience.

Organized Directory Support:
 Keep your files well-organized.

Secure Storage: 
Create a password-protected area for all your movies and videos.

Wide Video Format Support: 
Compatible with MP4, M4V, MOV, RMVB, AVI, 3GP, and more.

Comprehensive Photo Format Support: 
Supports JPG, GIF, PNG, and other popular formats.




Developer Note:
For existing users, please read the update notes before upgrading to ensure a smooth transition.

Experience the best in cloud storage and file safety with Pandora Drive.
